_doc: FIX-3 R1: download sources of the ONNX Runtime files (site/vendor/ort/, onnxruntime-web 1.31.1) written into manifest.runtime.<backend>.sources by scripts/lib/runtime_manifest.mjs (called from scripts/chunk_models.mjs). chunkMirrors serve the repo's own site/vendor/ort/<file> for the git tag ({tag} is substituted) and apply to the backends listed in `backends`: jsDelivr's GitHub endpoints refuse files above 20 MB, so the 28.7 MB WebGPU binary (ort-wasm-simd-threaded.asyncify.wasm) is not listed for them and comes from the npm copies instead. npm[] are the official onnxruntime-web@1.31.1 package files, byte-identical to the vendored ones (sha256 verified: evidence/runtime_sources_probe.json, 2026-11-05); {file} is substituted per file key. Probe notes 2026-11-05 (curl with a browser Accept-Encoding + 1 KB Range, from this machine): GitHub Pages (origin) and unpkg / npmmirror answer .wasm compressed (gzip) with Range on the compressed bytes or ignored → the loader streams the whole file from them (one request, 7.3 MB on the wire for the 28.7 MB file); raw.githubusercontent.com, ghfast.top, ghproxy.net, cdn.jsdmirror.com/npm and jsdelivr.b-cdn.net/npm answer clean uncompressed 206 ranges → resumable per byte; cdn.jsdelivr.net and fastly.jsdelivr.net answer Range on a brotli representation → whole-file stream. jsdelivr.b-cdn.net/gh reset every connection during the probe and is not listed; cdn.jsdmirror.com/gh answered 403 on first contact (cold cache) and 200/206 afterwards.
